projects.title: IT Service Desk Analytics Dashboard
projects.desc: Analyzed 97,498 IT support tickets over five years to evaluate operational performance and customer satisfaction. Built an interactive dashboard using Pivot Tables, Pivot Charts, KPI cards, slicers, and conditional formatting. Generated business recommendations to improve ticket resolution efficiency, resource allocation, and service quality.

projects.title: Stock Market Prediction Using LSTM
projects.desc: Built an LSTM deep-learning model to forecast stock prices from historical financial time-series data. Benchmarked model performance against Moving Average and Exponential Smoothing baselines. Pre-processed financial data through normalization and sequence generation, tuning with Adam optimizer and dropout regularisation.

projects.title: MBTI-Based Movie & Music Recommender
projects.desc: Responsive single-page web app that generates personalised movie & music recommendations from an interactive 16-question MBTI quiz. Integrated OMDb API for real-time movie data and dynamic search-link generation for Spotify & YouTube. Mobile-first, dark-themed UI deployed on GitHub Pages.
